newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL noon rubber steady, little interest seen.
newsitem.headline: KL noon rubber steady, little interest seen.

text.p: Malaysian rubber market was steady at Monday's closing levels with prices hardly moving in the absence of keen offtake and following uncertainty in Tokyo.
"There was little consumer interest this morning," a dealer at a trading firm said. "We are expecting a South Korea tender for SMR grades for nearby shipment," a dealer said.
Sellers were offering SMR CV at 326 cents, SMR L at 305, SMR 5 at 268, SMR 20 at 256 and latex at 222.
"Europeans are only seen covering on a small scale as most of them have already met their requirements before the summer holidays," the trader said.
Some local dealers were covering for sheet and SMR grades, but some consumers were looking to buy forwards right until December, dealers said.

""We are not willing to commit ourselves too much in forwards positions," said a trader at a plantation firm. "We may get better prices towards end of the year when the rainy season starts which may lead to a shortage of raw materials."
At midday, both July RSS1 and July SMR 20 buyer were unchanged at Monday's 282 cents ($1.12) and 257.50 cents a kg respectively.
